tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// rdo rje gur gyi le 'brel bzhugs// ༄༅// 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi le'u'i 'brel rnam par gzhag pa zhes bya ba/ dpal kye'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyud 'di'i brjod bya'i gtso bo rigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i rnam gzhag le'u dang por bstan/ dkyil 'khor de la mchod pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi gar dgos pa dang bcas pa gnyis pas bstan/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i gtor ma'i cho ga dang*/ ming gi tshogs gsum pas bstan/ de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor gong nas bstan pa'i rgyud rgyas pa'i rnam gzhag dang*/ phyag rgya dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba dang*/ khro bo bcu'i srung 'khor dang bcas pa bzhi pas bstan/ dbang thob pa des lha bsgom pa sems dpa' sum brtsegs dang*/ rigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam gzhag phyag mtshan gyi dag pa dang bcas pa lnga pas bstan/ de nyid phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas gdab pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi tshad dang*/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gzhug pa sngags kyi bzlas pa dang bcas pa drug pas bstan/ bskyed rim de nyid yan lag drug gis bsdus pa bcud len dang bcas pa bdun pas bstan/ bskyed rim gyi yan lag zhu ba glus bskul ba dang*/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ las rgyas pa sgrol ma la sogs pa'i las tshogs dang bcas pa dang*/ lam gyi rtsa ba bla ma bsten tshul dang bcas pa brgyad pas bstan/ de ltar bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa bstan nas sku gzugs rab tu gnas pa dang*/ drod thob par byed pa'i thabs drag shul gyi sgrub pa dang bcas pa dgu pas bstan/ drod thob pa des spyod pa bya ba bcu pas bstan/ spyod pa byed pa la las bzhis sems can rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs bcu gcig pas bstan/ thun mong dang*/ mchog sgrub pa gnyis ka'i thabs bskyed rim gyi spyi'i rnam gzhag bcu gnyis pas bstan/ lam gyi grogs dam tshig dang*/

spyod pa bcu gsum pas bstan/ bskyed rim gyi yan lag thun mong gi dngos grub dang*/ bskyed rim nyid sbyong bar byed pa rdzogs rim dang*/ rim pa gnyis kyi rnam gzhag sbyin sreg dang bcas pa bcu bzhi pas bstan/ rim pa gnyis mthar phyin pas nye rgyu bsgoms nas 'bras bu la mtshams sbyor ba bco lnga pas bstan to// rdo rje gur gyi le'u'i 'brel rnam par gzhag pa 'di/ lcags pho spre'u'i lo/ dbyar zla 'bring po la rgyal po'i pho brang du bshad pa'i tshe/ 'phags pas sbyar ba'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
